# Flappy FMS

> Flappy FMS is a free online arcade flight game created for the Faculty of Management Studies (FMS) community and gamers worldwide. Players soar as a red eagle through glowing neon pillars across three game modes, using six collectible power-ups, competing on the FMS Campus Leaderboard, and unlocking 28 achievements. Play instantly in any web browser without ads, downloads, or account registration, or install as a Progressive Web App (PWA) for 100% offline gameplay.

## Project Summary

- **Title**: Flappy FMS
- **Alternate Names**: Flappy Eagle, Flappy FMS Arcade
- **Genre**: Arcade, Flight, Endless Runner, HTML5 Casual Game
- **Primary Website**: https://flappyfms.vercel.app/
- **Source Repository**: https://github.com/abhy-kumar/flappyfms
- **Author & Developer**: Abhishek Kumar (https://github.com/abhy-kumar, abhiks177@gmail.com)
- **Publisher Entity**: Faculty of Management Studies (FMS), University of Delhi Community
- **Pricing**: 100% Free ($0.00), No Microtransactions, No In-App Ads
- **Platforms Supported**: Web Browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, Opera), Mobile (iOS Safari, Android Chrome), Tablet (iPadOS), Desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux), Progressive Web App (PWA)

## Key Features & Gameplay Mechanics

### 1. Game Modes
- **Classic**: Standard arcade flight mechanics with gradual difficulty scaling. Obstacle speed and gap clearance adjust progressively as score increases.
- **Hardcore**: Fast-paced, high-intensity mode featuring oscillating vertical pillars and narrower gap clearance for advanced players.
- **Zen**: Relaxed, peaceful flight mode with wide gaps, low gravity, and constant speed for stress-free casual play.

### 2. Six Power-Ups
- **Golden Feather**: Grants +5 bonus points instantly (doubled to +10 if 2× Points is active).
- **Shield Orb**: Absorbs one collision with an obstacle, saving the flight run.
- **Slow-Mo Clock**: Reduces pillar scroll velocity by 45% and gravity by 25% for 6 seconds.
- **Magnet**: Pulls all floating collectibles within proximity directly to the eagle for 8 seconds.
- **2× Points**: Multiplies all point gains by 2 for 10 seconds (stacks multiplicatively with combo multipliers).
- **Ghost Phase**: Grants incorporeal phasing through solid pillars without crashing for 5 seconds.

### 3. FMS Campus Leaderboard & Hall of Fame
- Live Top 10 Hall of Fame ranking pilots with custom Pilot Call Signs (e.g., `FMS_Ace`, `FinanceHawk`, `BatchOf26`).
- Filter rankings by `ALL`, `CLASSIC`, `HARDCORE`, and `ZEN`.
- Persistent local client storage with seamless cross-tab synchronization.

### 4. Combo Multiplier & Close Call Mechanics
- Clearing consecutive pillars without hitting obstacles builds a score combo multiplier up to 5× (increments every 5 consecutive pipes).
- Skimming tightly through gaps (<20px clearance) triggers "Close Call" / "Near Miss" bonus points.

### 5. 28 Achievements & Awards
- Score milestone badges (First Flight, Eagle Eyes, Storm Rider, Legend of FMS, Sky Immortal).
- Streak and precision awards (Daredevil, Precision Ace, Solar Flare).
- Power-up mastery awards (Sky Arsenal, Purist, Ghost Walk, Bounced).
- Mode mastery and dedication trophies (Classic Ace, Iron Wings, Zen Master, Campus Legend).

## Technical Architecture

- **Rendering Engine**: HTML5 Canvas with sub-pixel interpolation and dynamic parallax sky gradients.
- **Physics Simulation**: Fixed 60 Hz physics timestep (`dt = 1/60s`) ensuring identical physics across 60Hz, 120Hz, and 144Hz displays.
- **Audio Engine**: Real-time procedural sound synthesis via Web Audio API (`AudioContext`) with zero external audio assets and zero latency.
- **Offline Capabilities**: Full Progressive Web App (PWA) with Service Worker (`sw.js`) precaching and Web App Manifest (`manifest.webmanifest`).
- **Data Persistence**: Safe, fault-tolerant `localStorage` state management with in-memory fallback.

## Controls

- **Desktop Keyboard**:
  - Flap / Ascend: `Spacebar`, `Up Arrow` (`↑`), or `W`
  - Pause / Resume: `Escape` (`Esc`) or `P`
  - Mute Audio: `M`
- **Mobile / Tablet Touch**:
  - Flap / Ascend: Tap anywhere on screen
  - HUD Actions: Dedicated on-screen buttons for Leaderboard, Pause, Sound, and Guide

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is Flappy FMS free to play?**
A: Yes, Flappy FMS is 100% free with no ads, paywalls, or registrations required.

**Q: Can I install Flappy FMS on my phone or tablet?**
A: Yes, it is built as an offline-ready PWA. Tap the "Install App" button in the menu or use "Add to Home Screen" in your browser.

**Q: What is the FMS connection?**
A: Flappy FMS is dedicated to the Faculty of Management Studies (FMS), University of Delhi gaming and student community, featuring an FMS Campus Top 10 Leaderboard.
